route_incident.description: The first failed preflight's unnecessary isolated-router restart caused the existing startup selection policy to choose Primary instead of the previously observed Secondary route. No switch endpoint, account operation or model request was used. The corrected deployment snapshots and preserves whichever valid route is current.

residual_risks: The valid browser-driven device-code enrollment and delete paths have not been executed against real credentials after deployment.
The in-app browser confirmed the signed-in composer and current route, but optional Statsig timeouts prevented a complete automated profile-menu DOM capture.

The helper is intentionally root-run. Its client surface is limited to a root-owned Unix socket, strict JSON enroll/remove requests, private same-owner source files, fixed catalog/store paths and a fixed account-router restart; this boundary must be re-audited if any path, group or protocol changes.
Account switching starts a new backend session. Cross-account seamless continuity, request replay and in-flight computation recovery remain unverified and are not claimed.
